body: docsync is wired into ubgo/auth: every constant a package README names is a //ds:def block (no space, keeps godoc clean) cited with [`Name`](ds:block?id=...); task docs:drift in the gate. Since 2026-10-01 .ds/config.toml uses include.mode=repo so the docs/ guides carry docsync-written code copies (tampered/stale caught by ds check). Grouped and typed consts both bind in ds v0.1.3. Open upstream: ubgo/docsync issue 2 (repo-mode source link is repository-relative).
